close_reason: MtaStsError: replaced DnsTxtInvalid(String) with DnsTxtMultipleRecords/DnsTxtMissingId/DnsTxtIdTooLong/DnsTxtIdInvalid/DnsLookupFailed; added PolicyFetchRedirectForbidden/PolicyFetchHttpError/PolicyFetchTooLarge. fetch_url now takes &str. All 291 smtp + 254 mail tests pass.
description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs fetch_url(url: String, ...) takes ownership of the URL string. The caller (fetch_mta_sts_policy_body) constructs the URL and moves it in; tests construct and move. client.get(&url) borrows it. The parameter should be &str — the function does not need ownership. Taking &str avoids forcing callers to construct an owned String before calling.
title: fetch_url takes owned String; &str suffices
